description: This Java source file defines the CohortValidator class, which implements validation logic for Cohort objects within the OpenMRS project. It checks for proper vaccination of patient objects and the consistency of cohort member dates.

classes.name: CohortValidator
classes.description: A class that implements the Spring Validator interface to validate Cohort objects, ensuring logical consistency of cohort memberships and date validity.
